requirement_text.REQ-003: Add 'en' to src/i18n/routing.ts's locales array (now ["ru","uz","en"]), defaultLocale stays "ru". Create messages/en.json matching messages/ru.json's 177-leaf-key structure, every value duplicated verbatim from ru.json as a placeholder except Metadata.ogLocale = "en_US". Acceptance criteria: locales array correct; messages/en.json key-set matches ru.json exactly with non-empty values; visiting /en renders <html lang="en"> with /ru and /uz unregressed; LocaleSwitcher renders three working options (RU/UZ/EN) navigating correctly between all three locale prefixes with anchors preserved; npm run build has no type/routing errors; /en renders all landing sections with no missing-translation-key errors.

task.description: This requirement has a real user-visible surface (a new /en route and a third LocaleSwitcher option), so run the full Step 3 procedure, not the docs-only skip. Write docs/agents/test-specs/REQ-003.md: a concrete, mechanically-runnable manual verification case for each REQ-003 acceptance criterion — exact route, exact viewport(s)/theme(s) if relevant, exact expected result. Cover: the locales array content, messages/en.json's key-set/value correctness (script-based check, name the exact comparison), /en rendering <html lang="en">, /ru and /uz non-regression, the three-way LocaleSwitcher's click-through behavior in both directions (into /en and out of /en back to /ru or /uz, with anchors preserved), build cleanliness, and no missing-translation-key errors on /en.
acceptance_criteria: Every REQ-003 acceptance criterion has at least one verification case
Each case names the exact route, viewport(s), theme(s), and expected result — not 'check it looks right'
No TODO left in the spec

result.summary: Wrote docs/agents/test-specs/REQ-003.md covering all 6 acceptance criteria with 7 verification cases (AC1-AC6, plus AC2b for the exact-value-diff check). Every case names an exact route, viewport/theme (or explicitly N/A), and expected result. Markup-exact assertions in AC3/AC4 (html lang attribute, .lang switcher HTML, root redirect, invalid-locale behavior) and the AC2/AC2b Node key-set/value-diff scripts were verified directly against a locally-booted npm run dev instance before being written into the spec, not assumed from the design doc alone. Found and corrected one incorrect assumption during verification: /xx (invalid locale) does not 404 directly, it 307-redirects to /ru/xx which then 404s -- spec reflects the real observed behavior. Dev server was stopped after verification.
